# GitHub Copilot

Thin router only. Not a second Atlas authority, launcher, workflow, or
review policy.

Start at [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and follow the read order it
defines. Obey [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) and
[`ARCHITECTURE.md`](../ARCHITECTURE.md). Do not invent household
financial facts or owner policy. `Forecast` is the financial
calculation authority. Do not create a second planner, generic
schema, store, or authority unless those files already authorize it.

One independently provable outcome per pull request. Run this
repository's required tests and checks. Complete the Atlas Merge Card
accurately.

**Copilot-specific execution.** Never merge your own pull request.
Stop for owner-reserved, security, destructive, or financial-authority
decisions.
